episodes.title: A Call to Arms
episodes.summary: Demons attack the polis near the home of the outcast Heron, who finds allies in the wise elder Elias and the fierce Amazonian warrior Alexia.

episodes.title: Past is Prologue
episodes.summary: After he completes a quest for adamantine ore, Heron learns the truth about his birth from his mother Electra, as well as the identity of his father.

episodes.title: The Raid
episodes.summary: The goddess Hera discovers the existence of Zeus's bastard son Heron and vows revenge. The polis falls to the forces of the malevolent Seraphim.

episodes.title: A Monster is Born
episodes.summary: Heron is taken captive by the army of Seraphim, who chases Alexia but instead encounters Hera. The goddess informs the demon leader of his true past.

episodes.title: Escape or Die
episodes.summary: Hera directs Seraphim to the powerful sword Zeus once forged for Heron, who is enslaved aboard a galley. Alexia seeks counsel from her mentor, Chiron.

episodes.title: Back to Olympus
episodes.summary: Zeus brings Heron to Olympus for training, angering the other gods. Alexia embarks on a mission to Melidoni with Heron's companions, Evios and Kofi.

episodes.title: The Fields of the Dead
episodes.summary: Seraphim's loyalties are tested when Zeus reveals Hera's deceptions. Alexia's company crosses the Fields of the Dead. War breaks out between the gods.

episodes.title: War for Olympus
episodes.summary: Hera resurrects the giants of the sea and assails Olympus, leading to an earth-shattering battle for the ages and the rise of a new demigod: Heron.

episodes.title: A Shadow Emerges
episodes.summary: Hades plots to steal a powerful stone from Zeus's temple while the battle for Olympus rages. Gaia sets Heron on a quest to save a former adversary.

episodes.title: Weights & Measures
episodes.summary: Seraphim faces harsh judgment in the Underworld and receives an unexpected offer from Hades, who reveals the true origin of the Eleusinian Stone.

episodes.title: Winter is Born
episodes.summary: Heron seeks guidance from the smithing god Hephaestus. To win Seraphim's allegiance, Hades tempts him with a promise to bring peace to a lost love.

episodes.title: Funeral Games
episodes.summary: While mourning their fallen king, the immortals honor Zeus with celebratory games. But the competition between Ares and Heron grows brutally violent.

episodes.title: Judgement Day
episodes.summary: Zeus is sentenced to his fate in the Underworld while Heron visits the land of his birth. Fueled by vengeance, Seraphim unleashes wrath upon an enemy.

episodes.title: Crossing Paths
episodes.summary: Heron and his companions fight a vicious swarm of Keres and encounter a surprising traveler along their journey. Demeter makes a bold play for power.

episodes.title: The Hidden Realm
episodes.summary: Aided by an Amazon fleet, Heron, Alexia and Kofi face the giant automaton Talos. To enter the Hidden Realm, Seraphim must first outsmart the Curetes.

episodes.title: The Three Trials
episodes.summary: With the crown of Olympus at stake, the gods clash swords in an epic battle for the Eleusinian Stone and the power it grants to whomever possesses it.

episodes.title: A Breath Before Dying
episodes.summary: Heron and Seraphim set forth on a mission of mercy while the heavens tremble with the rage of Typhon, who rains destruction down on the gods of Olympus.

episodes.title: Hades' Choice
episodes.summary: To protect those she holds dear, a selfless immortal confronts a towering terror. Freed from bondage, Cronos vows to teach the gods the meaning of fear.

episodes.title: Hellebore
episodes.summary: In the Underworld, the vengeful king of the Titans puts Hades' love to the ultimate test. Seraphim reveals his perilous plan to save Gorgo from torment.

episodes.title: Brothers' Journey
episodes.summary: Cronos schemes to weaken Zeus as the Olympians bid farewell to their fallen brethren. Old allies lend their swords in a clash against a colossal foe.

episodes.title: The Head of the Maenads
episodes.summary: While seeking an oracle to help guide them on their quest, Heron and his companions intrude upon a mysterious cult and their gruesome blood sacrifice.

episodes.title: The Tower of the Winds
episodes.summary: A humbled Hera pleads for aid on Zeus' behalf. In the home of the wind gods, Heron's search party fights a dark force that pits friend against friend.

episodes.title: Land of the Dead
episodes.summary: Two star-crossed soulmates reunite on the bank of the River Styx. Facing insurmountable odds, the last remaining Olympians square off against Cronos.

episodes.title: A Champion's Challenge
episodes.summary: With the fate of the gods at stake, the immortals and the Titans invoke the ways of old and settle their dispute through an epic battle of champions.
